vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: tickerdb
Version: 0.1.6

The tickerdb skill bundle is a standard integration for a financial market intelligence API. It provides instructions for an AI agent to handle authentication, query market data, manage watchlists, and set up automated cron jobs for daily reports, all of which are consistent with its stated purpose. There is no evidence of malicious intent, data exfiltration to unauthorized parties, or harmful prompt injection; the use of 'openclaw config set' for API key persistence is a documented feature of the OpenClaw ecosystem.

llm.summary: The skill is internally consistent with its stated purpose: it only asks for a TICKERDB API key and instructs the agent to call tickerdb.com APIs and manage a watchlist/report; nothing requested appears unrelated or excessive.

dimensions.detail: Name/description match the runtime instructions: the SKILL.md only describes authenticating to TickerDB, calling the TickerDB API endpoints (summary, search, watchlist), and setting up reports/watchlists. The single required credential (TICKERDB_KEY) is appropriate for this purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions include an interactive onboarding flow that asks for the user's email and a 6-digit verification code, posts these to the TickerDB auth endpoints, and displays/saves the returned apiKey. This is coherent for account setup, but it means the agent will collect an email and verification code and may persist the API key if the user agrees.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: This is an instruction-only skill with no install spec and no code files, so nothing is written to disk by the skill itself — lowest-risk installation surface.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Only TICKERDB_KEY is required and declared as the primary credential. No other secrets, config paths, or unrelated environment variables are requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false (normal). The skill's onboarding asks to persist the API key via the platform if the user consents — expected, but users should be aware the key may be stored by the platform.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do what it says: call TickerDB APIs and manage watchlists/reports. Before installing or using it, consider: (1) only provide the TICKERDB_KEY and your own email/verification code — do not share other credentials; (2) be aware the skill will offer to save/persist the API key in your account if you consent — if you prefer, keep the key off-platform or create a scoped/revocable key from TickerDB; (3) review TickerDB's privacy and webhook behaviour if you accept daily reports or webhooks; (4) monitor and rotate the API key if you stop using the skill. There are no other obvious mismatches or hidden requests in the skill instructions.
